name: Cashbox Partyworld Co., Ltd.
summary: Cashbox Partyworld Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of audio-visual equipment for singing in Taiwan. The company operates through the Singing Audio-Visual Equipment; Food Manufacturing and Wholesale; and Crop Cultivation segments. It is also involved in distribution and sales of audio-visual equipment and supplies; restaurant operations; food manufacturing and wholesale businesses; advertising business; agricultural crop cultivation and wholesale; and provision of management consulting for audio-visual singing.
